summary: Carriage Services, Inc., a Delaware corporation listed on the NYSE under CSV, filed a Form 8-K on September 30, 2026, reporting entry into a new $300 million five-year senior secured revolving Credit Agreement with JPMorgan Chase Bank, N.A. as Administrative Agent. The facility replaces the Existing Credit Agreement, bears interest at Alternate Base Rate or Term SOFR plus a leverage-based margin, includes a $100 million accordion, and is secured by substantially all personal property and pledged equity. This is a routine refinancing, not a special situation.
